explorations.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / stylized-concept. Create a professional modeller's EXTERIOR turnaround sheet of ONE consistent fictional MindKore low-poly game prop based on an RMB-93 shotgun. Reference image 1 is the USER-APPROVED DESIGN MASTER for receiver shapes, sparse original-style hardware, dark steel/burgundy polymer palette and the tiny integrated amber gas-discharge numeral window. Reference image 2 is the real weapon reference for overall silhouette and folded stock above upper magazine tube. Do not redesign.
Produce a clean large landscape technical concept sheet with SIX separate full-object orthographic views, all completely uncropped and with generous space: LEFT SIDE at top left, RIGHT SIDE at top right, TOP at middle left, BOTTOM at middle right, FRONT (looking at muzzle) bottom left, REAR (looking from grip toward muzzle) bottom right. Main profile rows occupy most area. Each view shows exactly the same object at matching scale where practical. Simple small labels only, exact labels LEFT, RIGHT, TOP, BOTTOM, FRONT, REAR. White/light warm gray background, subtle gray grounding only, flat studio light showing every silhouette. No grid, dimensions, mechanisms, exploded internals, decorative borders, extra typography.
Critical side identity: left side view muzzle points LEFT, pistol grip to RIGHT; right side view muzzle points RIGHT, grip LEFT. The amber numeral 4 is inset ONLY on the weapon's LEFT receiver wall, above the low narrow side lever and below the folded stock. Absolutely no counter on right, top, bottom, front or rear. The right receiver side is plain with only minimal original-type dark pins, NOT a mirror of the left-side controls.
Outer anatomy: two perfectly straight parallel tubes, UPPER tube is closed-end magazine, LOWER is barrel with a dark muzzle bore; a narrow folded metal shoulder-stock strip rests above the upper tube and lies forward along it, not a rifle stock. No expanded rear shoulder stock: separate angled pistol grip below rear. Long ribbed black polymer fore-end around lower front assembly, restrained dark oxblood strips. Narrow simple triggerguard. Plain dark receiver panel, modest black stock pivot at upper rear, one modest dark low pin and thin flat elongated side lever above triggerguard. NO big hinge around grip. NO bright silver screws, red-centred screw heads, bolt-covered frame, random access panels, decorative rails, optic, laser or flashlight.
The counter is a single recessed rounded rectangular smoked-glass window with a thin dark lip and muted oxblood gasket integrated into the receiver wall, NO screw-on plate. Inside: fine amber wire-outline 4 with subtle darker unlit wires behind; modest glow with readable line, no ticks or ruler or adjacent capacity text. Must match image1 exactly in character.
Render as a sophisticated believable LOW-POLY PBR hard-surface asset design: clean large planes, deliberate 10-12-sided cylindrical silhouettes, small restrained bevels, believable matte dark steel, dull worn phenolic plastic and rubber, selective edge wear, no all-over crackle. No cartoon toy exaggeration, cell shading, doodle lines or glossy sci-fi excess. Original utilitarian proportions; straight rather than bent or swollen. Exterior visual references only, not fabrication drawings. Prioritize cross-view consistency of proportions, original hardware positions and LEFT-ONLY counter.
